verdict.rationale: Salv is a compliance SaaS platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only a REST/OpenAPI, OAuth2 tokens, webhooks and Slack status updates. None of it mentions an MCP server or any first-party agent connection endpoint, and the API is only a building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
